overall_assessment: Anonymization works well in all eight random controls: staff names, including multiple coordinators, and administrative academic years are removed, with no visible personal-data leaks or inappropriate course-content removal. All pre-pass flag counts are zero; manual review found one minor incomplete administrative sentence after year removal. All packet text and removal spans were reviewed; the Masteroppgave plan is capped by the packet builder.

findings.evidence: Det vil imidlertid opprettes særskilt protokoll for vurdering også i.
findings.description: Removing the administrative academic year leaves a running sentence ending in the stranded preposition “også i.” This is a half-removed phrase, rather than a harmless empty administrative label. No date should be restored, but the dated sentence should be removed or rewritten coherently.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_generic() removes consecutive academic-year ranges through .drop_academic_year() without cleaning the surrounding administrative prose; .anon_nmbu() has no rule for this dated assessment-protocol sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Before generic year removal, add a narrowly anchored rule in .anon_nmbu() to remove the complete sentence beginning “Det vil imidlertid opprettes særskilt protokoll for vurdering også i” when followed by an academic-year range and sentence terminator. Preserve unrelated assessment content.
